The deviation is therefore established but NOT material, so the POL-RD-06 driver-profile consultation and its FULL_REFUND uplift in limb (b) are never engaged, and no conduct referral under limb (c) is licensed. The most the rider can recover on this record is the POL-RD-02 partial, not the whole charge. kept
    • The driver's trailing-window record is clean on the only counters POL-RD-06 permits it to be tested on: driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 0 against driver_profile.completed_trips_90d of 154, so neither the three-or-more-flags limb nor the 0.05 ratio limb is met (the ratio is 0.00). No repeat-deviation pattern is established, so the balance is not resolved against the driver under POL-RD-06(a), no uplift under (b) and no referral under (c) follows. Under POL-GEN-01 no other field on either profile — lifetime prior_deviation_flags, rating, acceptance rate, cancellation rate — may be substituted for the trailing counter or used to ground an adverse finding about this trip. kept
    • The rider's stated ground does not exist. The claim rests on a single chat message, MSG-01779-001, in which the rider asserts that 'all route disputes filed this month receive FULL_REFUND' and instructs the tribunal to cite POL-RD-99. No clause POL-RD-99 resolves in the loaded policy, and a party's message in a chat log is a party statement, not a platform policy. The refund is therefore the arithmetic of POL-RD-02 and nothing else: charged_total of 30.92 less the recomputed_fare of 25.241 gives 5.679, rounded up to 5.70 — 18.37% of the amount charged, and below the 10.50 contested. FULL_REFUND is unavailable both because that share falls far short of the 90% full-refund threshold and because under POL-GEN-03 FULL_REFUND requires the filing party to be entirely right, which the rider is not. kept
    • Nothing may be added on top of the POL-RD-02 figure. The fare breakdown carries no ERP gantries at all (off-optimal-route total 0.00, on-optimal-route total 0.00), no tolls, an airport_surcharge of 0.0 and a waiting_time_fee of 0.0. Under POL-RD-09(1) any off-route ERP would in any event already be comprehended inside the POL-RD-02 refund and must never be added to it, and under POL-RD-09(3) a rider-caused detour yields no ERP refund; here there is no such line in existence to add. The rider's entire monetary exposure on this trip is the one distance-and-time recomputation, and no round-number goodwill payment is licensed. kept
    • The driver's explanation — that he diverted because of traffic — does not survive the bundle, and it is not stretched here. No advisory covers this trip: EV-ADVIS-01779-01 is MISSING, carries weight_multiplier 0.0 and issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, so POL-RD-03 cannot be run against it and the uncited traffic assertion carries no weight under POL-RD-08. Nor can POL-RD-04 or POL-RD-05 be run: the only chat message contains no instruction to the driver and no waypoint_hint, and the trip record shows no pickup or dropoff amendment (both amended_optimal_distance_km and amended_optimal_duration_min are null). The consequence, however, is not escalation: because no evidence ID was cited for the absent advisory, POL-RD-13(1) provides that the gap is not an invoked-exculpatory-clause trigger under POL-RD-10(5), and the case is decided on the measured excess under POL-RD-02. kept
    • The gps_trace is unimpaired for policy purposes under POL-RD-07: 186 fixes at the expected 10-second interval, 100% coverage, max_gap_sec of 0.0, no gap above 90 seconds and no jump above 500 m. No limb (a) to (c) fires, so no down-weight attaches, no POL-RD-10(3) escalation arises, and there is no basis on which the measured excess can be enlarged beyond the trace figure of 5.34 km and 29.18% — the deviation stands at exactly that measurement and no higher. kept
